sources: https://www.washingtoncountymn.gov/1820/Camping-Reservations (2026 season, rates, St. Croix Bluffs campground features, policies)

values.note: 20- or 30-amp site $35 a night, 50-amp with water $45; $6 off a night in October. The $50 water-and-sewer rate is for sites St. Croix Bluffs does not offer to the public (sewer at camp-host sites only). Changes cost $8; cancel at least three days ahead for a refund less the reservation fee; no refunds for weather.

fees.source: https://www.washingtoncountymn.gov/1820/Camping-Reservations ('20 or 30 amp Campsite $35 per night', '50 amp Campsite with water $45 per night', '50 amp Campsite with water and sewer $50 per night', 'Reservation Fee (per site, non-refundable) $8', 'In October, modern, rustic, and hike-in sites at Lake Elmo Park Reserve and St. Croix Bluffs Regional Park are discounted $6 per site, per night', 'Daily permit is $7, or an annual permit is $30', 'Maximum of 8 people per site'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Online or by phone (651-430-8370). The 14 nights are counted across all Washington County campgrounds in any 30 days. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.; the gate closes at 10 p.m. (code from the park office).

booking.source: https://www.washingtoncountymn.gov/1820/Camping-Reservations ('Campsite reservations will open 120 days before the campers' desired arrival date'; 'Weekends: 2-night minimum stay (Friday and Saturday). Holiday weekends: 3-night minimum stay. 14-day maximum stay at any Washington County campground in any 30-day period.'; 'Make Online Reservation' -> washcoparks.usedirect.com; 'Call the Parks office at 651-430-8370'), read 2026-11-11

season.source: https://www.washingtoncountymn.gov/1820/Camping-Reservations ('The 2026 campground season begins Friday, April 24 and ends Saturday, October 17, 2026.'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://www.washingtoncountymn.gov/1820/Camping-Reservations (St. Croix Bluffs: 'Twenty-six pull-through campsites with water and 20/30/50 amp electric hook-ups. Camp host/work camper sites include sewer hookup.'), read 2026-11-11

sites.source: https://www.washingtoncountymn.gov/1820/Camping-Reservations (26 pull-through, 'Thirty-six back-in campsite with 20 or 30 amp electric hookups, #1-36', 'Sites 37-47 are tent-only sites without electricity'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.washingtoncountymn.gov/1820/Camping-Reservations ('Modern bathroom with flush toilets and private hot shower rooms. Trailer/RV dump station.') + campground map ('Water Spigots located throughout the campground'), read 2026-11-11

note: Washington County regional park on the wooded bluffs above the St. Croix River; the campground is on the upland, the boat launch down at the river. 26 pull-through water/electric sites in a grid and 36 back-in electric sites on a wooded loop (1, 2, 4, 6, 22-24, 31 and 34 are 20-amp only); sites 37-47 are tent-only. No pets except service animals, and no alcohol. --Claude
summary: County camping page + campground map read: 2026 season Apr 24-Oct 17, $35 (20/30-amp) to $45 (50-amp + water), $6 off in October, $8 reservation fee, $7/$30 vehicle permit, 8 people a site, UseDirect booking 120 days ahead, 2-night weekend/3-night holiday minimums, 14-night max; high $50 -> $45 (sewer only at host sites). Pin is at the park entrance on St. Croix Trail, ~1.2 km west of the campground.
